title: Holographic Charged Transport with Higher Derivatives
summary: We compute the first-order hydrodynamic transport coefficients (shear viscosity $η$, bulk viscosity $ζ$, and charge conductivity $σ$) for a broad class of strongly coupled, four-dimensional charged relativistic gauge theory plasma with holographic gravitational duals containing higher-derivative corrections. The landscape of our holographic models captures non-conformal gauge theories with an arbitrary number of relevant coupling constants and a general scalar potential in the gravitational dual, allowing for a systematic exploration of charged transport along generic holographic RG flows.…
